request.query: finite product inequality for a nonnegative submultiplicative map taking one to at most one

items.name: Finset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : CommSemiring R] [inst_1 : PartialOrder R] [IsOrderedRing R] {M : Type u_4}
  [inst_3 : CommMonoid M] (f : M → R),
  (∀ (a : M), 0 ≤ f a) →
    f 1 ≤ 1 → (∀ (x y : M), f (x * y) ≤ f x * f y) → ∀ (s : Finset ι) (g : ι → M), f (∏ i ∈ s, g i) ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, f (g i)

items.name: Multiset.le_prod_of_submultiplicative_on_pred_of_nonneg
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid α] [inst_1 : CommMonoidWithZero β] [inst_2 : PartialOrder β]
  [PosMulMono β] (f : α → β) (p : α → Prop),
  (∀ (a : α), 0 ≤ f a) →
    f 1 ≤ 1 →
      (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → f (a * b) ≤ f a * f b) →
        (∀ (a b : α), p a → p b → p (a * b)) →
          ∀ (s : Multiset α), (∀ (a : α), a ∈ s → p a) → f s.prod ≤ (Multiset.map f s).prod
